Transport & Logistics Services
Ontime Logistics is a professional, family run business based in Kent. Over 16 years we have grown into a leading national container transport company delivering transport solutions to global shipping lines, freight forwarders, logistics companies and retailers, we pride ourselves on our exceptional level of service.
We employ over 30 staff and operate a fleet of 44 tonne vehicles with a range of trailers enabling us to accommodate a variety of haulage needs. Our LEZ compliant fleet is managed and maintained by our in-house team so it is kept in the best possible condition.
We have the knowledge, experience and capability to deliver your container on time and our vehicles are fitted with the latest tracking devices so their movements can be monitored in real-time. With careful planning and load consolidation we are able to reduce ‘empty miles’, help to lower costs and minimise our carbon footprint.

Ontime Logistics combine the expertise you may find at a larger haulage company with the personal level of service you can only get from a family-run business. Based in Kent, we’ve been around for more than 16 years and operate out of all the main ports throughout the United Kingdom.
We service blue chip clients in Europe and deliver our reliable transport solutions to container shipping lines, freight forwarders, logistics companies and retail distributors.
We are privately owned and have a modern, well-maintained growing fleet of trucks and a variety of multi functional trailers. Our trucks are largely Scania, Volvo, DAF and Mercedes, servicing both fixed or extendable skeletal trailers and Intermodal or temperature controlled units.
As a fully licensed haulage company with full goods in transit insurance and liability cover, we provide scheduled transport services collecting and delivering all types of goods and produce throughout the UK.

What We Do
We provide bespoke and efficient road transport services to support customers, end users and their supply chains throughout the UK.
Our core services consist of container transport, chilled and ambient distribution built up over many years and has been developed to meet our clients’ precise needs.
Our services span from the container port to warehouse, retail store, RDC and provide highly flexible, competitively priced transport solutions that can be adapted to the changing demands of our customers.
We are ideally placed to meet all of your container transport needs. We service blue chip clients in Europe and deliver our reliable transport solutions to container shipping lines, freight forwarders, logistics companies and retail distributors.
We play an increasingly critical role in the international supply chain, moving containers between the main seaports and consumer centers across the UK in a timely, seamless, efficient and cost effective way.
Call our logistics experts for a competitive quote and enjoy our award-winning customer service.
